paragraphs: An outbreak of Salmonella linked to broccoli sprouts remains ongoing, with 22 cases and 2 hospitalizations across 4 states [1]. Evergreen Fresh Sprouts LLC of Moyie Springs, Idaho is recalling 215 cases of broccoli sprouts due to potential Salmonella contamination [9]. A separate outbreak of E. coli O145 linked to frozen blueberries is also active, with 17 cases and 6 hospitalizations across 2 states [3].

The Cyclospora outbreak linked to iceberg lettuce that affected thousands is now over; it caused 12,883 cases, 570 hospitalizations, and 2 deaths across 21 states [2]. Danone USA is voluntarily recalling So Delicious Dairy Free Salted Caramel Cluster Non-Dairy Frozen Dessert pints with best-by dates on and before April 3, 2028, due to potential foreign materials such as small stones in the cashew inclusions [4][20]. Whole Foods Market is recalling Fromagerie Coop de Mean Cabricharme cheese because it contains egg lysozyme, an egg white protein not declared on the label, which poses a risk to people with egg allergies or sensitivities [7][26].
